target: docs/41-试点课堂Start持久迁移内核SDD.md
focus: closure of round-7 key delivery and HMAC derivation issues
trusted local account and receipt-first integrity boundary
summary: The private-runtime-parameter wording is replaced with protected inherited-handle/pipe delivery, and task_hmac/trace_hmac derivation now matches the pre-call tool_started ordering with post-call AuditEntry verification. ACL/mode, threat-boundary, receipt-first, and artifact retention controls are present. The SDD does not explicitly require a fresh independent cryptographically random key per case or prohibit runtime reuse of the fixed golden key.

round7_dispositions.evidence: §4 says tool_started derives task_hmac from the Store-verified capability task ID and trace_hmac from Store-generated decision ID, then tool_result compares them to Registry AuditEntry.
§3 and §6 consistently require a protected inherited handle/anonymous pipe and forbid argv/environment/log/dump delivery.

Case setup creates a key with CREATE_NEW/O_EXCL, but no explicit runtime requirement says the key is fresh, cryptographically random, independent per case, or never copied/reused; the fixed golden key's runtime prohibition is not stated.

findings.title: Fresh independent HMAC key per case is not explicit
findings.evidence: §3 requires supervisor-created case key and exclusive atomic creation; §45 defines a fixed golden key. No key entropy/length/uniqueness/non-reuse requirement distinguishes runtime key generation from the test vector.
findings.risk: Reused keys permit cross-case correlation of deterministic task_hmac/trace_hmac values and expand the impact of one case's key compromise.
findings.required_revision: Require a fresh independent OS-CSPRNG key per case (for example, 32 random bytes), prohibit copying/reusing across case directories, and explicitly mark the fixed golden key as test-only and rejected by runtime harness. Preserve exclusive creation and protected handle delivery.

control_dispositions.task_trace_hmac_ordering: closed_in_design; pre-call Store-derived values cross-checked against post-call AuditEntry
control_dispositions.receipt_first_recovery: limited to structural consistency within trusted-account boundary

remaining_conditions: Specify fresh independent cryptographically random key generation per case and explicitly prohibit runtime key reuse or use of the fixed golden test key.
limitations: No tests or runtime validation were run.
No ACL/mode, key-generation/transfer, build-artifact, database, or recovery path was inspected.
This review does not approve implementation, production deployment, real student data, or classroom readiness.
